title: The Shadows of Kisii
description: Exiled in the fortified stockade of Kisii Prison near Lake Victoria, Mekatilili must search the compound at night and locate Wanje.

objectives.description: Sneak through the stockade shadows and locate Wanje's detention cell.
Infiltrate the colonial warden's office to seize the iron stockade keys.
Unlock Wanje's cell door and coordinate the night breakout.

reward_text: Wanje is freed from his cell! The path to the outer gate is open.
